protocol.affine_adapter: log h_target = intercept + slope * centered log source risk; fixed optimizer and slope L2 for every condition and sample size
protocol.inference: paired deltas clustered by seed; deterministic 20000-resample percentile bootstrap 95% CI; two-sided exact sign test excludes ties
protocol.sign_gate: select affine repair iff its target-calibration slope is negative; otherwise preserve the source model; never consult target test
protocol.source_fit: source train; global scale on source validation
protocol.split: SHA-256 rank of group_id and split seed only; maximum pool frozen before outcomes; nested calibration subsets; common held-out test
protocol.target_fit: each adapter fits only its labeled target calibration subset; no hyperparameter or method selection on target test
protocol.target_per_context: strong transductive target-only MLE that sees the same context identities in calibration and test
